summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K furnishing a joint press release with NewPhotonics announcing the start of high-volume shipments of laser-integrated, serviceable optical engine PICs for AI interconnect. The release covers 800G and 1.6T PIC products built on Tower's PH18DA silicon photonics platform, with CPX-MSA compliant 6.4T chipsets slated for volume shipment in 1H27. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine product-commercialization announcement with no special-situation or deal terms; no risk-arb angle applies.
